item.title: fix(ci): repair test-type breakage from generated image actions
item.summary: fix(ci): repair test-type breakage from generated image actions The image-actions feature landed with an untyped fetch spy and an unknown URL argument; newer vitest types surface both. Capture anchor downloads via a typed mock implementation and coerce the probed block URL. Also add the toolCallId/itemId fields to the Discord harness's stale local copies of the onToolStart/onCommandOutput payload types (canonical type already has them).
